title: A 318-follower account makes a "lil Obsidian plugin" that sorts todos with fractional indexing
summary: On Wed 18 Nov 13:22Z @qustrolabe.bsky.social (318 followers) posted: "fractional indexing (www.npmjs.com/package/frac...) with strings is pretty neat concept", explaining that "you can always have index that's between two other lexicographically so drag'n'dropping row doesn't require shifting hundreds of indexes below or above", and ending "made lil Obsidian plugin to sort todos by priority that way" (23 likes, 2 replies; the replies are not in the digest). The post has a screenshot with no alt text and links the npm package, not the plugin.
